title: Office automation & IoT
summary: Lighting, climate and energy controlled from one place, with sensors that respond to how the office is used.
intro: Automation that saves energy and makes the office easier to run. We integrate lighting, blinds, air-conditioning and power with occupancy and environmental sensors, so the space responds to how people use it, and give your facilities team one place to see and control it.

points.title: Lights that respond
points.text: Scenes for meetings and presentations, with occupancy and daylight sensors that switch and dim lighting automatically.

points.title: Lower energy bills
points.text: Lighting and air-conditioning run only where and when they are needed, with energy monitoring to show the savings.

points.title: Data on how space is used
points.text: IoT sensors for occupancy, temperature and air quality, so you can plan space and comfort on real numbers.

points.title: One place to control it
points.text: Central dashboards, schedules and mobile control for your facilities team.

includes: Lighting control: scenes, dimming and schedules
IoT sensors for occupancy, temperature and air quality

faqs.question: Can automation be added to an existing office?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. Many lighting and sensor systems are wireless or reuse existing wiring. We survey the site and tell you what can be added without major civil work.

metaDescription: Office automation and IoT in Mumbai: lighting control, occupancy and air-quality sensors, climate integration and energy monitoring for commercial spaces.
